components.description: Federal FMLA leave: 12 workweeks of unpaid, job-protected leave for eligible employees (12 months and 1,250 hours) for a birth, a placement for adoption or foster care, care of a child in the first 12 months, the employee's own serious health condition, or care of a seriously ill spouse.
components.faculty_group_note: eligible employees; Employees may be eligible for FMLA leave if they have been employed by the University
components.eligible_parent_wording: Birth of a child; Placement with the employee of a child for adoption or foster care; Care of a spouse/domestic partner
components.entitlement_note: A statutory entitlement ('grants eligible employees the right'): guaranteed.
components.duration_note: 12 work weeks over a calendar year (the page's measuring period); statute: 12 workweeks during any 12-month period (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)).
components.medical_certification_note: for the employee's own serious health condition (certified by their health care provider) and for care of a family member (certified by the family member's health care provider); none stated for birth or placement
components.service_requirement: at least 12 months (consecutive or non-consecutive) and at least 1,250 hours in the preceding 12 months
components.time_window: care of a child during the first 12 months following birth or placement
components.relief_note: A leave of absence; relief not stated, so every duty relieved (R9).

notes: The rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3) applies: missing = no_policy_on_page. The only usable source is 2018_00_link, the SMU Human Resources 'Leave of Absence and FMLA' page (Wayback capture 2017-11-15). It is an HR summary page, not a governing document for faculty leave.

What the page contains: Adoption Leave (benefit-eligible staff, 3 weeks paid, primary caretaker; c1); Extended Leave (Unpaid) (staff, discretionary, any purpose including medical leave beyond balances; c3, general_purpose); FMLA Leave (all eligible employees, so it reaches faculty; c4, statute verified against 29 U.S.C. 2612/2611); Maternity Leave (benefit-eligible female staff, 6 weeks normal / 8 caesarian at usual wages; c2); Military and Civic Leave, Military Caregiver Leave and Qualifying Exigency Leave (not parental; C4 not_components); Paid Medical Leave (accrued sick leave of the staff member; c5).

Governing document missing: no faculty handbook, faculty leave policy, parental-leave, modified-duties or tenure-clock policy covering SMU tenure-stream faculty is among the saved sources. The page names no faculty policy. The document's version note says the governing faculty document is the SMU University Policy Manual's faculty family and medical leave policy (behind a login in 2015-2018, not obtained); that document is not saved and its terms are unknown. Faculty figures beyond FMLA are not determinable from the saved sources.

Faculty coverage: only c4 (FMLA) is coded main_campus_tenure_stream; the adoption, maternity, extended and paid medical leave provisions name staff ('staff employee', 'female staff', 'staff member') and are coded with those groups. Paid Medical Leave names the 'staff member' among its uses; whether faculty accrue it is not stated.

Cited but not saved: The Employee's Guide to the Family and Medical Leave Act (U.S. Department of Labor) (flagged on c4); 'Benefits Guide 2017' and 'Benefits Guide 2018' and the 'Eligibility' and 'Life Events' pages (navigation links); the 'Staff Leave of Absence form' (a form, not a policy). Vacation leave is mentioned (accrual continues during leave; Extended Leave follows it) but no vacation provision is stated, so it is not a component.
summary_only flags: c1, c2, c3, c5 are stated only on this HR summary page; no governing staff policy is saved. They are not faculty provisions in any case.

Chain, birth parent (tenure-stream faculty): FMLA 12 workweeks (unpaid, statutory) is the only faculty provision found; no faculty paid leave or relief in the saved sources. (Staff birth parent: Maternity Leave 6/8 weeks with FMLA concurrent; accrued Paid Medical Leave within FMLA; Extended Leave (Unpaid) after balances are exhausted.)
Chain, non-birth parent (tenure-stream faculty): FMLA 12 workweeks (unpaid, statutory). (Staff: accrued Paid Medical Leave for care of a spouse, within FMLA.)
No calendar, leave limit or all-sources cap is stated. Reference date 2018-02-24.
